jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

As our new Senior Research Scientist, you will play a leading scientific role in developing drug products across Novo’s development pipeline. You will apply your formulation expertise and industry experience across early- and late-stage projects, working with peptides, proteins, antibodies and minibinders to create stable, high-quality products that can reach patients worldwide.

You will join Chemistry, Manufacturing & Control (CMC) Development in Drug Product (DP) Development, where promising molecules are transformed into drug products that can progress through development and towards patients. As a Senior Research Scientist in DP Development, you will independently lead formulation activities and provide scientific direction from early development through later clinical stages. With sound judgement, strong ownership and a collaborative approach, you will guide colleagues, influence development decisions and help identify the right path forward for new medicines. Apply today!

What you’ll do

In this senior role, you will drive formulation and process development activities, ensuring robust pharmaceutical characteristics and product stability. You will take end-to-end scientific ownership within projects, anticipate formulation challenges and translate complex data into clear recommendations. You will also support, guide and develop colleagues, helping the team plan effectively and deliver with quality and confidence.

Your key outcomes will be to:

• 
Independently design, prioritise, interpret and report formulation studies that support the development of injectable drug products.

• 
Lead the planning and execution of studies in close collaboration with scientists, laboratory technicians and specialists, including coordination of team activities and priorities.

• 
Take ownership of high-quality documentation for internal and external purposes, including clinical trial applications and patent submissions.

• 
Provide scientific guidance, share formulation knowledge and support colleagues in making sound development decisions across the portfolio.

• 
Build strong cross-functional relationships and represent formulation perspectives with stakeholders across the Novo Nordisk value chain.

What you’ll bring

To succeed in this senior position, you bring a strong scientific foundation, substantial hands-on experience from industry and a proven ability to drive drug product development activities independently. You can turn complex formulation questions into clear scientific recommendations, make well-reasoned decisions and communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders from different backgrounds.

The qualifications we are looking for include:

• 
A PhD or Master’s degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering or another relevant natural science field.

• 
Solid industry experience within research and development and drug product development. This is a mandatory requirement.

• 
Strong hands-on experience with injectable protein, peptide, antibody or minibinder formulation and stability studies.

• 
Experience with phase-appropriate quality expectations, scientific documentation and drug product development across clinical phases.

Additionally, you are fluent in written and spoken English and comfortable working in a multi-stakeholder environment. Experience with clinical trial application documentation, patent submissions, cross-functional portfolio knowledge sharing or coordination of team activities will be an advantage.

On a personal level, you are self-driven and proactive, taking ownership of progress and delivering on commitments. You work independently, contribute positively to the team and build strong, trusting relationships. You apply sound judgement to bring clarity and direction to scientific questions, and support, lead and guide colleagues by sharing expertise, offering constructive input and modelling high scientific standards and collaboration. You plan, coordinate and balance priorities effectively, helping the team achieve shared goals in a dynamic environment.

Who you’ll work with

In CMC DP Development, we are approximately 200 colleagues working on developing formulations and production processes for injectable and oral biopharmaceutical products. You will work closely with scientists, laboratory technicians, specialists and project stakeholders across Global Research, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Analytical Development and Global Manufacturing and Supply. The collaboration spans projects from early development through late-stage development and process validation.

What you can expect here

At Novo Nordisk, you can expect a role where your scientific judgement matters and where you will have the mandate to shape formulation strategies and move complex development projects forward. You will have opportunities to deepen your expertise, strengthen your cross-functional influence and contribute as a senior scientific role model in a collaborative environment.

You will be trusted to work independently, take ownership and guide others, while contributing to work that helps create progress for people living with serious chronic diseases.

jobs.occupation: Associate Director, Centre for Functional Assays & Screening Therapeutics Discovery
jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

Lead the people and capabilities that make functional assays possible across our early drug discovery portfolio. As Associate Director in the Centre for Functional Assays & Screening (CFAS), you will lead a department of 12 scientists and technicians, with responsibility for delivering the cell lines that enable high-quality and high-throughput drug candidate screening.

Your impact will extend beyond your own team. You will bring together our Molecular Biology & Cell Line Development community, shape laboratory operations and automation, and work closely with scientific partners to turn research needs into clear priorities. As part of CFAS's shared co-leadership model, you will also help set the direction of the centre and take joint responsibility for its success.

What you’ll bring

You are an experienced research people leader who can combine scientific understanding with clear priorities and thoughtful decision-making. You build trust, listen to different perspectives and are comfortable sharing responsibility with peer leaders.

• Demonstrated people leadership experience, preferably at least two years, including responsibility for team development, priorities and delivery

• A PhD in life sciences or equivalent scientific qualifications and relevant experience

• Scientific expertise relevant to molecular biology, cell line development or cell-based research, with an understanding of functional assay requirements

• A customer-oriented mindset and strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to understand scientific needs

• Proven track record of improving research workflows and laboratory operations, with demonstrated experience leading laboratory automation initiatives.

• Ability to set clear direction and expectations while collaborating with peer leaders to make joint decisions and share accountability for CFAS.

What you’ll do

• Lead and develop a team of scientists and technicians, creating an environment built on trust, psychological safety and clear accountability

• Lead the Molecular Biology & Cell Line Development community, developing capabilities and ensuring timely delivery of cell lines that meet functional assay needs

• Build strong partnerships with internal stakeholders, translating scientific needs into priorities and balancing project commitments with team capacity

• Take operational leadership of CFAS laboratory facilities, setting direction for laboratory automation and improving workflows, facility use and efficiency

• Ensure scientific quality and timely delivery of two high-priority CFAS commitments: in vitro immunogenicity assessment of early candidates and transfer of robust cell-based potency assays to CMC

• Share leadership with your two fellow CFAS leaders, jointly setting priorities, developing capabilities and coordinating resources across the centre

Who you’ll work with

You will join CFAS within Drug Function & Screening, part of Therapeutics Discovery. The centre consists of three teams working together to enable functional assay development, screening and characterisation in early drug discovery. You will work side by side with your two fellow CFAS leaders. Through this shared co-leadership model, you will make joint decisions, coordinate resources and build capabilities that support the centre as a whole. It is a collaborative research environment where colleagues work across disciplines and therapeutic areas to help progress novel therapeutics from research ideas towards lead candidate selection.

What you can expect here

You will have the opportunity to combine people leadership, scientific direction and operational responsibility in a role with impact across early drug discovery. You will shape cell line capabilities and laboratory operations while developing a skilled team and building strong partnerships across research.

The environment calls for open collaboration and shared leadership. You will have the scope to improve how the centre works while ensuring that scientific quality and reliable delivery remain at the heart of its contribution.

Are you passionate about transforming scientific discoveries into robust manufacturing processes?

Join our Manufacturing Process Engineering environment and play a key role in scaling laboratory processes into pilot-scale manufacturing solutions that support the development of innovative therapies. As a Pilot Scientist, you will combine scientific expertise, process development, and hands-on problem solving to help deliver active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) for clinical and non-clinical development.

This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of science and manufacturing, where your contributions will directly influence how new medicines are developed and brought closer to patients.

The Position

As a Pilot Scientist, you will be responsible for the scientific development, scale-up, and execution of manufacturing processes. You will work with purification of API, while ensuring compliance with quality, safety, and regulatory requirements.

You will take scientific ownership of allocated projects and collaborate with scientists, technicians, engineers, and stakeholders across the organization to develop robust and scalable manufacturing solutions.

Your key responsibilities will include:

· Leading, coordinating, executing, and reporting scientific activities within process development and pilot-scale manufacturing.

· Supporting the scale-up of laboratory processes into robust and reproducible pilot-scale manufacturing processes.

· Acting as scientific lead for assigned projects and technical development activities.

· Supporting the production of active pharmaceutical ingredients for clinical and non-clinical studies.

· Designing and optimizing equipment set-ups to ensure safe, compliant, and efficient process execution.

· Preparing scientific, technical, and regulatory documentation, including development reports and technical design review input.

· Ensuring data integrity and high-quality scientific documentation in accordance with quality standards.

· Providing scientific guidance to technicians, including troubleshooting, training, and knowledge sharing.

· Participating in cross-functional project teams and technical design reviews.

· Driving continuous improvement initiatives, including LEAN activities and knowledge-sharing efforts.

· Ensuring compliance with GxP, quality, environmental, health, and safety requirements.

Qualifications

To succeed in this role, you have a strong scientific foundation combined with an interest in translating complex laboratory processes into scalable manufacturing solutions.

You hold:

· An education on Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, Chemistry or other related fields, or equivalent practical experience.

· Experience within process development, bioprocessing, manufacturing process engineering, API production, or a related scientific discipline.

· Knowledge of process scale-up and pilot-scale manufacturing activities.

· Experience with cultivation, recovery, purification processes, or modified proteins, peptides, and side-chain technologies.

· An understanding of regulated environments, including GxP, quality management systems, data integrity, and scientific documentation.

· Strong scientific communication, documentation, and stakeholder collaboration skills.

Experience with API manufacturing, equipment design and set-up, contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), contract research organizations (CROs), or technology transfer activities is considered an advantage but is not required.

As a person, you are

· Curious and motivated by scientific problem-solving.

· Proactive, accountable, and solution-oriented.

· Comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively across functions.

· Able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

· Skilled at communicating complex scientific concepts to different audiences.

· Passionate about continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and teamwork.

Working at Novo Nordisk

You will join a collaborative scientific environment in Bagsværd, where scientists and technicians work together to develop, scale, and execute manufacturing processes. While the role has no direct people management responsibility, you will provide scientific leadership and support to technicians working on your projects.

You will collaborate closely with colleagues across Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls Development, Quality Assurance, Research & Development, Regulatory Affairs, and Product Supply. Depending on project needs, you may also engage with external partners such as CMOs, CROs, equipment suppliers, and consultants.

The role offers significant scientific ownership, broad exposure across process development and manufacturing activities, and the opportunity to influence how future manufacturing processes are designed, optimized, and implemented.

We are looking for a Senior Biologist to provide project-level scientific leadership for DHI MUSE and other avian ecology assignments. You will define research questions and analytical scope of projects, guide ecological interpretation, own the scientific reporting and act as external and internal stakeholders’ scientific point of contact. You will work closely with other biologists, data scientists, radar experts, offshore engineers, software developers and project managers.

• Lead the scientific scoping, study design and research question definitions for assigned projects.

• Interpret results of data analysis in their ecological context and account for sensor performance and other confounders.

• Own scientific reports, technical notes, presentations and the scientific content of client proposals through internal review and client approval.

• Act as scientific point of contact in dialogue with clients, regulators, project teams, suppliers and subcontractors.

• Review scientific deliverables and proposals, respond to review comments and advise when available evidence cannot support a requested conclusion.

• Help maintain consistent scientific working practices and actively share knowledge within the team and company.

Qualifications and personal skills

We are looking for a colleague with the following qualifications:

Required:

• Master's degree or PhD in biology, ecology, ornithology or a closely related discipline, or otherwise relevant experience in ornithology.

• Demonstrated experience designing ecological studies and interpreting complex, multi-source datasets.

Desirable:

• Experience in R, Python or other tools used for data analysis.

• Knowledge of reproducible analysis, data quality assurance or quantitative ecology.

• Instrumentation experience, i.e. developing test plans, conducting test, evaluating results and deriving performance specifications for some equipment.

• Fluent in Polish, written and spoken.

• Scientifically rigorous and comfortable making evidence-based decisions.

jobs.description:
Design solutions that solve whole classes of problems rather than individual tasks. As a Senior SRE at Systematic, you keep the systems running that healthcare staff and patients depend on.

Would you like to shape the future of our infrastructure by designing scalable, elegant solutions that solve classes of problems rather than individual tasks? Join our skilled Site Reliability Engineering team where you’ll have the opportunity to think beyond the immediate fix and architect systems that transform how we operate at scale. Your work will keep healthcare solutions running for the clinicians and care staff who depend on them.

The job

As a Senior SRE with a systems engineering mindset, you’ll work at the intersection of deep technical expertise and strategic thinking. You’ll identify patterns across our diverse infrastructure, from Kubernetes clusters to Azure VMs, and create unified solutions that eliminate entire categories of operational toil. This isn’t about fixing one deployment pipeline; it’s about building a framework that makes all deployments reliable. This isn’t about patching one vulnerability; it’s about architecting a security posture that scales across our organization.

You’ll have access to cutting-edge technologies and the autonomy to innovate, with opportunities to work across multiple environments including our ao-admin Kubernetes cluster, Docker-based deployments, Azure-hosted infrastructure, and healthcare-focused systems. When you are ready, you will join the SRE team’s on-call rotation.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Architect automation systems that eliminate classes of manual work, thinking in terms of platforms and capabilities rather than individual scripts

• Develop infrastructure tooling that empowers development teams to self-service their operational needs while maintaining reliability standards

• Build observability frameworks that provide unified insights across diverse environments, making patterns visible and actionable

• Create abstraction layers that hide complexity while providing powerful capabilities, whether through Terraform modules, Helm charts, or custom operators

• Drive infrastructure evolution by identifying systemic improvements and leading their implementation from concept to production

• Collaborate with development teams to understand their patterns of needs and design operations-ready solutions that scale

• Mentor team members in systems thinking and architectural approaches, sharing your problem-solving methodology

• Apply best practices in site reliability engineering, advocating for solutions that improve reliability, security, and maintainability at scale

• Research and prototype emerging technologies and approaches, evaluating their fit for solving our systemic challenges

Joining the team

You’ll join one of our two skilled SRE teams, each consisting of approximately 10 professionals working from our offices in Aarhus and Bucharest. Our teams operate with a DevOps philosophy and use a mix of Scrum and Kanban methodologies depending on the project needs.

We value engineers who can see the forest and the trees, who understand both the technical details and the broader patterns. You’ll work with colleagues who manage everything from Kubernetes clusters to Windows VMs, from Terraform modules to Prometheus monitoring, and you’ll help us find the common threads that allow us to operate more efficiently and reliably.

This is a role with significant room to manoeuvre and influence. You’ll have the opportunity to work with the newest technologies while solving real operational challenges that impact critical systems across multiple domains. Our healthcare solutions, such as Columna, support the continuum of care across hospitals, communities and private homes, so your work contributes directly to patient safety.

Your qualifications

Our ideal candidate is someone who gets excited about patterns, who sees a specific problem and immediately starts thinking “what other problems does this represent?” You’re the engineer who, when asked to automate a deployment, designs a deployment framework. When asked to fix a monitoring gap, you create an observability strategy.

Our ideal candidate would have:

• Experience as a Senior in site reliability engineering, systems engineering, or platform engineering roles with demonstrated impact on infrastructure scalability

• Solid understanding of abstraction and design patterns in infrastructure, with experience creating reusable frameworks, modules, or platforms

• Experience with observability at scale, including metrics, logging, and tracing systems (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar)

• Strong communication skills to articulate architectural decisions, document systems, and mentor others in systems thinking

• Proven ability to architect solutions that solve multiple problems simultaneously, with examples of platforms or systems you’ve built

We value diverse backgrounds and encourage candidates who are passionate about systems thinking, infrastructure architecture, and solving problems at scale to apply, even if they do not meet every requirement perfectly!

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

As Maintenance Support Professional, you will help keep critical technical installations running, support compliance-based maintenance, and contribute to the proper and structured close-down of the old factory as we prepare for a new innovative production facility to fully take over.

**

Your role**

You will provide technical support for the planning, implementation and development of maintenance across utilities, technical installations, plants and production equipment at Site Ballerup. You will act as a technical problem-solver, resolve technical issues in daily operations while also supporting larger transformation activities related to the factory transition.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Supporting day-to-day operation and availability of both the old and newest state of the art technical installations and equipment.

• Acting as troubleshooter on ad hoc technical assignments, breakdowns and operational challenges.

• Ensuring maintenance documentation is maintained, optimized and aligned with LEO Pharma policies and GxP requirements.

• Creating, Reviewing and technically approving documents in QMS in close collaboration with stakeholders.

• Supporting the structured close-down of the old factory and contributing to a smooth transition towards the new facility.

You will also be responsible for GxP documentation from the section, including documentation in CMMS and QMS. In addition, you will support timely follow-up on deviations, corrective actions, action items and CAPAs, and act as technical SME in root cause analysis related to deviation handling. You may also participate in relevant CAPEX projects as participant or package owner and lead smaller OPEX projects.

**

Your qualifications**

We imagine that you bring solid technical expertise, good documentation discipline and experience from a regulated environment. You are used to working across functions and can communicate clearly with colleagues and stakeholders at different levels of the organisation.

We are looking for someone with:

• An educational background as an engineer, marine engineer, process technician or equivalent.

• 5+ years’ experience with maintenance of utilities, technical installations, plants or production equipment.

• Hands-on experience with deviation handling, root cause analysis, CAPAs or similar processes.

• Knowledge of GxP, technical documentation and regulated quality processes.

• Experience with CMMS systems such as PEMAC and quality systems such as Veeva Quality is an advantage.

• Experience with RCM (reliability centred maintenance) is an advantage.

As a person, you are proactive, structured and solution-oriented. You enjoy troubleshooting, can manage several tasks at the same time, and are motivated by collaborating across departments to find practical and compliant solutions. You communicate with confidence, build trust with stakeholders and contribute to a positive, LEAN-oriented culture. Working with an optimisation perspective and a focus towards improvements.

**

Your new team**

You will join Maintenance Support at Site Ballerup. We are a team that plays an important role in securing stable technical operations and compliant maintenance. We work closely with Operational Maintenance, Engineering, production areas and laboratories, and we support both daily operations and strategic site changes. Together, we are helping LEO Pharma close one chapter in a responsible way while preparing for the next generation of innovative production.

**

Contact and application**

For additional information, please contact Adam Lundsby Rejkjaer, Senior Team Leader, Maintenance Support at BDYDK@leo-pharma.com

**Welcome to Trading & Revenue

• Collaborating with internal and external analysts to refine market views

• Collaborating directly with the Senior Trader to refine hedging and prop trading strategies

• Performing deep-dive market research on themes that drive power prices across Europe

• Providing fundamental inputs for our price forecasting models and analytics

• Mentoring and educating colleagues on power market dynamics

• Improving our products including price forecasts and trading signal

• Contributing to growing our trading PnL.

• Have a proven track record of supporting hedging and proprietary trading decisions, with demonstrated impact on positioning and results

• Have deep understanding of European power market fundamentals and their interaction with forwards, options, and curve dynamics

• Have strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to form clear, well reasoned market views under uncertainty

• Have the ability to communicate complex analysis into decisive, trader ready recommendations

• Have a Master’s degree in economics, finance, energy, engineering or a related quantitative field or a Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA®) designation.

**It would be great if you also have:

**

• Experience with North-Western European power markets specifically

• Familiarity with fundamental power market stack modelling concepts

• Experience mentoring or coaching junior analysts

• A passion for continuous improvement, innovation, and knowledge sharing

• Proficiency in Python and experience with statistical analysis and time series analysis.
